text: DUDE Products, maker of DUDE Wipes, is headquartered in Chicago. After a strategic growth investment from private equity firm TSG Consumer Partners announced in June 2025, founders Sean Riley (CEO), Jeff Klimkowski (CFO) and Ryan Meegan (CMO) retain significant ownership stakes and continue to lead the company in their current executive roles.
short: DUDE Products: Chicago; founders retain significant stakes and lead the company; TSG Consumer invested 2025.

source.name: TSG Consumer – 'DUDE Wipes Secures Strategic Growth Investment from TSG Consumer'
source.quote: Founders Sean Riley, Chief Executive Officer, Jeff Klimkowski, Chief Financial Officer, and Ryan Meegan, Chief Marketing Officer, will retain significant ownership stakes
